selectionRule: Among thresholds retaining at least 60% of development selections at 5/5, maximize descriptive Wilson lower bound of hit rate; ties use smaller thresholds. Lock before evaluating later dates.
candidateRule: Most recent earlier box roster; no selected-day results, participation or injuries used. DNP counts as a missed selection, separately reported.
firstBasketConditionalRule: Separate sensitivity only: filter earlier eligible candidates to eventual final-box starters; never included in pregame metrics or tuning.
limits: Corrected 2025-26 archive was already inspected. Retrospective time-ordered holdout, not unseen live evidence. No 2024-25 gamebook archive to validate cross-season fallback.
weights: Keep one-third offense, defense and opportunity. No weight optimization.
